instruction: By when should everything from my today's amazon order arrive? Tell me the date in MM-DD format.
notes: Pure information-retrieval task: no database changes are allowed, so the goal only demands the knowledge predicate (found-arrival-date) plus (task-completed). The plan is: get passwords, log in to amazon, list orders to identify the one placed today, show that order to read every item's delivery date (the latest one is the answer), and finish with supervisor.complete_task passing the MM-DD date. The static (arrival-date-of todays-order latest-arrival-date) fact is just a placeholder naming the runtime answer object; (placed-today) marks the order the show_orders lookup must select. All non-final actions require (not (task-completed)), and only complete_task asserts it.
